buttonGpio.label: Button GPIO
buttonGpio.description: GPIO pin for the user button, can be remapped on boards with multiple buttons

buzzerGpio.label: Buzzer GPIO
buzzerGpio.description: GPIO pin for the PWM buzzer

nodeInfoBroadcastSecs.label: Node Info Broadcast Interval
nodeInfoBroadcastSecs.description: How often node information is sent. Defaults to 900 seconds.

doubleTapAsButtonPress.label: Double Tap as Button
doubleTapAsButtonPress.description: Treat double tap on supported accelerometers as a user button press.

disableTripleClick.label: Disable Triple Click
disableTripleClick.description: Disables the user button triple-press shortcut.

ledHeartbeatDisabled.label: LED Heartbeat
ledHeartbeatDisabled.description: Controls the blinking LED on the device.  For most devices this will control one of the up to 4 LEDS, the charger and GPS LEDs are not controllable.

positionBroadcastSecs.label: Broadcast Interval
positionBroadcastSecs.description: The longest a node will go without broadcasting a position.

fixedPosition.label: Fixed Position
fixedPosition.description: The last known latitude, longitude and altitude are broadcast over the mesh on the position interval, rather than a live GPS fix.

gpsUpdateInterval.label: Update Interval
gpsUpdateInterval.description: How often to try to get a GPS position.

positionFlags.label: Position Flags
positionFlags.description: Optional fields to include when assembling position messages

broadcastSmartMinimumDistance.label: Minimum Distance
broadcastSmartMinimumDistance.description: The minimum change in distance before a smart position broadcast is considered.

broadcastSmartMinimumIntervalSecs.label: Minimum Interval
broadcastSmartMinimumIntervalSecs.description: The shortest interval between position updates once the minimum distance has been met.

isPowerSaving.label: Power Saving
isPowerSaving.description: Will sleep everything as much as possible, for the tracker and sensor role this will also include the lora radio. Don't use this setting if you want to use your device with the phone apps or are using a device without a user button.

onBatteryShutdownAfterSecs.label: Shutdown on Power Loss
onBatteryShutdownAfterSecs.description: How long after external power is removed before the device powers off. Zero to disable.

wifiEnabled.label: WiFi Enabled
wifiEnabled.description: Enabling WiFi will disable the bluetooth connection to the app.

wifiSsid.label: SSID
wifiSsid.description: WiFi network name to connect to

ntpServer.label: NTP Server
ntpServer.description: NTP server address. Defaults to meshtastic.pool.ntp.org

ethEnabled.label: Ethernet Enabled
ethEnabled.description: Enabling Ethernet will disable the bluetooth connection to the app.

enabledProtocols.label: Enabled Protocols
enabledProtocols.description: Enable broadcasting packets via UDP over the local network.

screenOnSecs.label: Screen on for
screenOnSecs.description: How long the screen remains on after the user button is pressed or messages are received.

autoScreenCarouselSecs.label: Carousel Interval
autoScreenCarouselSecs.description: Automatically moves to the next screen page, like a carousel, on this interval.

compassNorthTop.label: Always point north
compassNorthTop.description: The compass heading on the screen outside of the circle will always point north.

units.label: Display Units
units.description: Units shown on the device screen.

headingBold.label: Bold Heading
headingBold.description: Bold the heading text on the screen.

wakeOnTapOrMotion.label: Wake Screen on tap or motion
wakeOnTapOrMotion.description: Requires that there be an accelerometer on your device.

compassOrientation.label: Compass Orientation
compassOrientation.description: Indicates how to rotate or invert the compass output for accurate display.

use12hClock.label: 12 Hour Clock
use12hClock.description: Sets the screen clock format to 12-hour.

usePreset.label: Use Preset
usePreset.description: Use the modem preset settings instead of a manual bandwidth, spread factor and coding rate

spreadFactor.label: Spread Factor
spreadFactor.description: Number of chirps per symbol, as 2 raised to this value.

codingRate.label: Coding Rate
codingRate.description: Error-correction redundancy, as the denominator of 4/n. Higher values survive noisier links but make every packet longer.

region.label: Region
region.description: The region where you will be using your radios.

hopLimit.label: Hop Limit
hopLimit.description: How many times a message may be repeated before it stops being forwarded.

txEnabled.label: Transmit Enabled
txEnabled.description: Allow the LoRa radio to transmit. Turn off while hot-swapping antennas or bench testing.

txPower.label: Transmit Power
txPower.description: Radio transmit power. Leave at zero to use the highest level legal for the region, which is what most radios should use.

channelNum.label: Frequency Slot
channelNum.description: Your node’s operating frequency is calculated based on the region, modem preset, and this field. When 0, the slot is automatically calculated based on the primary channel name.

sx126xRxBoostedGain.label: RX Boosted Gain
sx126xRxBoostedGain.description: Enable RX boosted gain mode on SX126X based radios

ignoreMqtt.label: Ignore MQTT
ignoreMqtt.description: Ignore packets received over LoRa that travelled via MQTT anywhere on their path.

fixedPin.label: Fixed Pin
fixedPin.description: Fixed PIN for Bluetooth pairing. Used when pairing mode is set to fixed PIN

publicKey.label: Public Key
publicKey.description: Generated from your private key and sent out to other nodes on the mesh to allow them to compute a shared secret key

privateKey.label: Private Key
privateKey.description: Used to create a shared key with a remote device

adminKey.label: Admin Key
adminKey.description: The public key authorized to send admin messages to this node

isManaged.label: Managed Device
isManaged.description: Device is managed by a mesh administrator, the user is unable to access any of the device settings.

serialEnabled.label: Serial Console
serialEnabled.description: Serial Console over the Stream API.

debugLogApiEnabled.label: Debug Logs
debugLogApiEnabled.description: Output live debug logging over serial, view and export position-redacted device logs over Bluetooth.

tlsEnabled.label: TLS Enabled
tlsEnabled.description: TLS is required for the public Meshtastic MQTT server.

proxyToClientEnabled.label: MQTT Client Proxy
proxyToClientEnabled.description: Utilizes the network connection on your phone to connect to MQTT.

mapReportingEnabled.label: Map Reporting
mapReportingEnabled.description: Your node will periodically send an unencrypted map report packet to the configured MQTT server, this includes id, short and long name, approximate location, hardware model, role, firmware version, LoRa region, modem preset and primary channel name.

publishIntervalSecs.label: Map Publish Interval
publishIntervalSecs.description: How often a map report is published.

shouldReportLocation.label: Report Location
shouldReportLocation.description: I have read and understand the above. I voluntarily consent to the unencrypted transmission of my node data via MQTT.

enabled.label: Neighbor Info Enabled
enabled.description: Enable neighbor info broadcasting. Periodically sends information about directly-heard neighbors to help visualize mesh topology.

updateInterval.label: Update Interval
updateInterval.description: How often to broadcast neighbor info.

transmitOverLora.label: Transmit over LoRa
transmitOverLora.description: Whether to transmit neighbor info over LoRa in addition to MQTT and PhoneAPI. Not available on channels with default key and name.

enabled.label: Detection Sensor Enabled
enabled.description: Enables the detection sensor module, it needs to be enabled on both the node with the sensor, and any nodes that you want to receive detection sensor text messages or view the detection sensor log and chart.

stateBroadcastSecs.label: State Broadcast Interval
stateBroadcastSecs.description: How often to send the detection sensor state to the mesh, whether or not anything was detected.

sendBell.label: Send Bell
sendBell.description: Send ASCII bell with alert message. Useful for triggering external notification on bell.

monitorPin.label: GPIO Pin to monitor
monitorPin.description: GPIO pin watched for state changes.

usePullup.label: Uses pullup resistor
usePullup.description: Whether or not use INPUT_PULLUP mode for GPIO pin. Only applicable if the board uses pull-up resistors on the pin

codec2Enabled.label: Codec2 Enabled
codec2Enabled.description: Enable Codec2 audio encoding/decoding for voice communication over the mesh.

bitrate.label: Bitrate
bitrate.description: The Codec2 bitrate to use. The sample rate is always 8 kHz. Lower bitrates use less bandwidth but reduce audio quality.

enabled.label: PAX Counter Enabled
enabled.description: When enabled the PAX Counter module counts the number of people passing by using WiFi and Bluetooth. Both WiFI and Bluetooth must be disabled for PAX counter to work.

paxcounterUpdateInterval.label: Update Interval
paxcounterUpdateInterval.description: How often we can send a message to the mesh when people are detected.

wifiThreshold.label: WiFi Threshold
wifiThreshold.description: RSSI threshold for counting WiFi devices.

bleThreshold.label: BLE Threshold
bleThreshold.description: RSSI threshold for counting BLE devices.

positionMinIntervalSecs.label: Minimum Position Interval
positionMinIntervalSecs.description: Positions from the same node arriving sooner than this are dropped.

nodeinfoDirectResponseMaxHops.label: Direct NodeInfo Max Hops
nodeinfoDirectResponseMaxHops.description: Only answer requestors within this many hops.

rateLimitWindowSecs.label: Rate Limit Window
rateLimitWindowSecs.description: The time window packets are counted over.

rateLimitMaxPackets.label: Rate Limit Max Packets
rateLimitMaxPackets.description: The most packets one node may send per window.

unknownPacketThreshold.label: Unknown Packet Threshold
unknownPacketThreshold.description: How many per window before the sender is dropped.

echo.label: Echo
echo.description: If set, any packets you send will be echoed back to your device.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: The amount of time to wait before we consider your packet as done.

outputMs.label: GPIO Output Duration
outputMs.description: In GPIO mode, how long to keep the output on.

output.label: Output pin GPIO
output.description: GPIO pin driven on notification. Defaults to the board's EXT_NOTIFY_OUT pin.

active.label: Active
active.description: If enabled, the 'output' Pin will be pulled active high, disabled means active low.

alertMessageVibra.label: Vibra Motor Alert
alertMessageVibra.description: Alert GPIO vibra motor when receiving a message

alertMessageBuzzer.label: Alert GPIO buzzer when receiving a message

alertBellVibra.label: Alert GPIO vibra motor when receiving a bell

alertBellBuzzer.label: Alert GPIO buzzer when receiving a bell

usePwm.label: Use PWM Buzzer
usePwm.description: Use a PWM output (like the RAK Buzzer) for tunes instead of an on/off output. This will ignore the output, output duration and active settings and use the device config buzzer GPIO option instead.

useI2sAsBuzzer.label: Use I2S As Buzzer
useI2sAsBuzzer.description: Enables devices with native I2S audio output to use the RTTTL over speaker like a buzzer. T-Watch S3 and T-Deck for example have this capability.

enabled.label: Store and Forward Enabled
enabled.description: Enables the store and forward module.

heartbeat.label: Send Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Send a heartbeat to advertise the server's presence.

isServer.label: Server
isServer.description: Enable this device as a Store and Forward server. Requires an ESP32 device with PSRAM.

sender.label: Sender Interval
sender.description: This device will send out range test messages on the selected interval.

save.label: Save
save.description: Saves a CSV with the range test message details, currently only available on ESP32 devices with a web server.

deviceUpdateInterval.label: Device Metrics Interval
deviceUpdateInterval.description: How often device metrics are sent over the mesh.

environmentUpdateInterval.label: Environment Metrics Interval
environmentUpdateInterval.description: How often environment metrics are sent over the mesh.

airQualityInterval.label: Air Quality Metrics Interval
airQualityInterval.description: How often air quality metrics are sent over the mesh.

powerUpdateInterval.label: Power Metrics Interval
powerUpdateInterval.description: How often power metrics are sent over the mesh.

deviceTelemetryEnabled.label: Broadcast Device Metrics
deviceTelemetryEnabled.description: Enable broadcasting device metrics to the mesh network. When disabled, metrics are only sent to connected clients.

inputbrokerPinA.label: Pin A
inputbrokerPinA.description: GPIO pin for rotary encoder A port.

inputbrokerPinB.label: Pin B
inputbrokerPinB.description: GPIO pin for rotary encoder B port.

inputbrokerPinPress.label: Press Pin
inputbrokerPinPress.description: GPIO pin for rotary encoder Press port.

current.label: Current
current.description: Drive current for the LED output.

red.label: Red
red.description: The red level of the ambient lighting LED.

green.label: Green
green.description: The green level of the ambient lighting LED.

blue.label: Blue
blue.description: The blue level of the ambient lighting LED.

broadcastIntervalSecs.label: Interval
broadcastIntervalSecs.description: How often a beacon is broadcast.
